[[File:Salve Graveyard Teleport icon (mobile).png|left|class=pageimage]]
'''Salve Graveyard Teleport''' teleports the caster to the [[River Salve]] graveyard, by the [[ghoul]]s at the entrance to [[Mort Myre Swamp]]. This spell is one of the quickest ways to a [[fairy ring]].

In order to cast this spell, players must have spoken to [[Tyss]] to unlock the [[Arceuus spellbook]]. In addition, the player must have completed the [[Priest in Peril]] quest and spoke to [[Drezel]], otherwise they will receive a message in the chatbox stating ''You must have completed Priest in Peril and received Drezel's warning to cast this spell.''
